source: Our World in Data — Annual CO₂ emissions (Global Carbon Budget)
unit: million tonnes of CO₂ per year (fossil fuels + industry)
note: Global fossil CO₂ emissions 1850–2024: from ~197 Mt in 1850 to a record 38,599 Mt in 2024 — still rising. Full annual series for the ten biggest emitting economies (1,640 country-year rows incl. the world series); China alone emits 12,289 Mt, more than the next two combined. EU-27 is listed as a bloc, so Germany appears both alone and inside it.
